text:
Rae (mktg): Heads-up: planning a 48h paid push for Sept 9 webinar. Goal: 3-day registration window + 48h burst around open. Need budget and swap rules by EOD. :mega:

Jon (growth): Budget ask? markets?

Rae (mktg): $1,200/day US + EU, 48h = $2,400. Target CPL <$50, attendance >=35%. Frontload 25% in first 3 hours to get momentum.

Mina (creative): I'll provide 3 hero images + 2 headline families. Recommend variant X (concise benefit) for search, variant Y (testimonial) for retarget.

Theo (analytics): Landing pages: split 60/40 LP-tech (detailed) vs LP-short (agenda). Add hidden field reg_uuid and GA4 event webinar_reg. UTM template: `utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=sept9_webinar&utm_content={creative}`

Alicia (ops): Lead routing: all regs -> SFDC campaign "Sept9_Webinar_PTF"; attended (>=30%) -> mark MQL and route to HubSpot SDR queue. Need Zap prod key after QA.

Jon (growth): Campaign skeleton: 4 search ad groups (inference, latency, infra, cost). Retarget: 7-day site visitors + 14-day video viewers. Bidding: Max conversions w/ tCPA $45.

Rae (mktg): Swap rules: if CTR <0.4% after 6h -> swap to Mina's variant Y. If CTR >1% but conv rate <7% -> force LP-short. Also cap spending: no more than 35% daily in first 4 hours.

Mina (creative): Copy snippets:
```
H1-A: Ship inference features faster	Join Sept 9
H1-B: Production LLM serving: live demo Sept 9
Desc: Live demo + checklist. Seats limited.
```

Theo (analytics): Tracking checklist: GA4 event `webinar_reg`, pixel fires on submit, session stitch via reg_uuid, hourly CPA dashboard tile. Alert: CPA > $60 -> ping @Jon and @Rae.

Alicia (ops): QA list before go: UTMs, pixel, form validation, Zap test to HubSpot, negative keyword list applied. I'll run staging Zap and share results.

ads-bot: Draft campaign created: campaign_id=cmp_sept9_200, draft_url=https://ads.internal/cmp_sept9_200

Jon (growth): For pacing, enable accelerated delivery first 3 hours then standard. Monitor first-hour CTR and convs; I'll post updates.

Mina (creative): Uploading assets now to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/sept9_assets (placeholder).

Rae (mktg): Approval ask: please approve H1-B for search if no objections by 4:30pm.

Theo (analytics): Approved H1-B. QA on tracking looks straightforward.

Alicia (ops): Staging Zap passed. Requesting prod key after final sign-off.

Rae (mktg): Thanks all. Final timeline: assets by 5pm, draft in ads UI by 7pm, QA + go-live tomorrow 9am PT. Will post go-live and first-hour snapshot here. End thread. :white_check_mark:
